notes.title: Update 1.0.4
notes.notes:
The following has been changed:

 Air time and game completion time stats update more accurately. This also results in the leaderboards for the respective stats being more accurate.
 Hitbox for the "Survived the Cave" achievement is more accurate to the location of the NPCs and van.


Thank you to everyone for playing the game, we hope you have been enjoying it!
Rock on!

notes.title: Small Update 1.0.3
notes.notes:
A new achievement has been added for finding the easter egg to our friends game that just released, GRIMWAR! 
Check out their game here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3649130/GRIMWAR/

Other fixes/changes:

The hitbox for the secret stash achievement has been made larger so it will be easier to hit.
Some audio clips in the game were not adjusted by your audio settings. These audio clips now adjust their volume based on your settings.


Thank you all for playing! Over the next couple weeks we plan to make a few more small changes. As always, let us know when you encounter any bugs and the team will get to fixing them.
Rock on!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
The following has been improved:

Mother erg boss turning has been further improved to prevent bugs with it


Thanks again for playing everyone! We will continue to fix bugs and improve the game to make it a more enjoyable experience.
Rock on!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
The following bugs have been squashed:

Mother erg boss dialogue interfering with Gope dialogue in the Mother Erg Den
Mother erg boss not turning to the second platform after the first is broken
Cutscene camera getting stuck and not going back to the player's camera
Inaccurate game completion time/Speedrun achievement rewarding when it shouldn't
A Prophecy Foretold achievement triggering when it shouldn't
Erg crawler stuck in the wall that wanted to be free
Some floating lights in the cave


We are incredibly grateful for all the feedback you have given us so far and for playing our game! We will try to make the game even more enjoyable for you.
Rock on!
